prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent whole-body sprite atlas for existing Korean magpie website mascot.
Input image is CHARACTER AND STYLE REFERENCE. Precisely match the FIRST bird in the reference: same cute rounded belly, head size, narrow white shoulder, thin dark belly contour, long tail diagonally up-right, charcoal silhouette, small white circular eye. Draw this same bird standing still, following a butterfly above its head (DO NOT draw butterfly).
Create SIX whole-bird poses in a clean 3 columns by 2 rows grid, read left-to-right. All six have EXACT same torso, wing, tail, leg proportions and same two planted feet position relative to cell; only neck and head naturally articulate:
1 top-left: looking LEFT horizontally, same as reference first bird.
2 top-middle: looking upper-left, beak tilted upward 25 degrees.
3 top-right: looking upper-left, beak tilted upward 55 degrees.
4 bottom-left: looking almost straight UP, beak upward 85 degrees, slight left profile.
5 bottom-middle: looking upper-RIGHT at 55 degrees (head turns, BODY stays left-facing).
6 bottom-right: looking upper-RIGHT at 25 degrees (head turns, BODY stays left-facing).
Each is one coherent hand-drawn bird, natural neck articulation, not detached head pieces. Keep each head the SAME SIZE, same circular eye diameter. Do not enlarge the head as it tilts. Feet on identical baselines, no walking, no body flip, no perspective size change. Spacious padding and clear separation, no overlap. Flat charcoal #2e2a26 and white plumage, clean silhouette. Genuinely transparent background, no shadows, no glow, no scenery, no floor, no labels or numbers. Preserve the reference's long elegant tail, belly shape and original cute plumpness.
